name: mem-gauge
description: A pressable memory gauge under the composer and a /mem pane: what is using this Mac's RAM across Claude sessions, agents, models and apps, with rule-based advice.

intervalSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often the gauge re-reads memory. 10 to 600; default 30.

idleMinutes.title: Idle after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: A session with no turn for this long and over 1 GB is offered 'wrap or archive' advice and an Ask to wrap button. Default 30.

contextTipTokens.title: Context tip at (tokens)
contextTipTokens.description: The Memory pane suggests Compact or Hand off once a session's context passes this many tokens (default 150000, the point where cost, latency and quality start to suffer whatever the window; 20000 to 1000000). 0 falls back to 80 % of the window.

statusLine.title: Also show the status line
statusLine.description: Off by default: the gauge row under the prompt (red ring icon + 'Memory 60% · Pressure ✓ · …', pressable) already carries the summary on the terminal and the desktop app. Turn on for VS Code or mobile, where that row is not drawn and the status line is the only gauge besides /mem.

footerButtons.title: Clickable footer figures
footerButtons.description: Draw the two footer figures as buttons that open the Memory and Disk panes (the desktop draws every button as a grey chip). Off, the figures are plain text and /mem and /disk open the panes.

footerCompact.title: One footer chip
footerCompact.description: Draw memory and disk as ONE tight footer chip, both as fullness percents (for example '◔38% ⛁59%'), that opens the Memory pane, where a Disk button opens the Disk pane. Use it when other mods also put chips in the footer: the desktop strip clips once the chips overflow it.
